column1: # Map our 22 in-vitro cell types -> Decima atlas tracks, using the REAL decima 0.7.2
# metadata vocabulary (obs['cell_type'] x obs['tissue'] x obs['organ']).
# KEY FINDING: Decima's atlas collapses ALL pancreatic islet endocrine cells into a single
# coarse label `enteroendocrine cell` (tissue 'islet of Langerhans'/'pancreas'). There is NO
# separate beta/alpha/delta/EC. So our endocrine subtypes below all map to the SAME tracks and
# zero-shot Decima cannot distinguish them (across-track specificity among them ~ 0). That gap
# is exactly what fine-tuning our 22 resolved states is meant to fill.
# decima_cell_type : exact value in obs['cell_type']. tissue_query/organ_query: optional '|'-sep
# substring filters. Healthy/NA-disease tracks are preferred automatically. Matched tracks are averaged.
